bootcd.command: cd {BUILD}/boot && /usr/bin/cmake -E env python3 {REPO}/tools/strip_cd_media.py --lst {BUILD}/boot/bootcd.Debug.lst --out {BUILD}/boot/bootcd.stripped.lst --cache {BUILD}/boot/stripped --objcopy {REPO}/.build-tools/llvm-mingw/bin/aarch64-w64-mingw32-objcopy && {BUILD}/host-tools/bin/mkisofs -quiet -o {BUILD}/bootcd.iso -iso-level 4 -publisher "ReactOS Project" -preparer "ReactOS Project" -volid ReactOS -volset ReactOS -eltorito-platform efi -eltorito-boot loader/efisys.bin -no-emul-boot -hide boot.catalog -sort {BUILD}/boot/bootfiles.sort -no-cache-inodes -graft-points -path-list {BUILD}/boot/bootcd.stripped.lst

bootcdregtest.command: cd {BUILD}/boot && /usr/bin/cmake -E env python3 {REPO}/tools/strip_cd_media.py --lst {BUILD}/boot/bootcdregtest.Debug.lst --out {BUILD}/boot/bootcdregtest.stripped.lst --cache {BUILD}/boot/stripped --objcopy {REPO}/.build-tools/llvm-mingw/bin/aarch64-w64-mingw32-objcopy && {BUILD}/host-tools/bin/mkisofs -quiet -o {BUILD}/bootcdregtest.iso -iso-level 4 -publisher "ReactOS Project" -preparer "ReactOS Project" -volid ReactOS -volset ReactOS -eltorito-platform efi -eltorito-boot loader/efisys.bin -no-emul-boot -hide boot.catalog -sort {BUILD}/boot/bootfiles.sort -no-cache-inodes -graft-points -path-list {BUILD}/boot/bootcdregtest.stripped.lst
